components.name: Broken arch/springing
components.function: Need broken-wall/arch foot/return variants and root-to-stone attachment views, not another intact Gothic church. Reuse existing crystal/wish-star and moss/fern families after identity check. Suspension of star is unresolved or explicitly magical; owl/moths and possible firefly effects proposed. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated broken arch/springing matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
